data.name: Dhiaa
data.gender_notes: Dhiaa is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Gives light, radiant, brilliant, beaming, shining. The name Dhiaa carries the meaning “Glowing” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Dhiaa usually hope their child will grow to embody glowing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a child who will bring light and joy to the world
data.etymology: Dhiaa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Glowing.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dhiaa total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: ذیا
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم ذیا مشتق من الجذر العربي ضيا الذي يعني النور والضياء، وله أهمية كبيرة في الإسلام حيث يوصف الله بالضياء في القرآن الكريم، ويتميز الأشخاص الذين يحملون هذا الاسم بالحكمة والإشراق

in_urdu.name: ذیا
in_urdu.long_meaning: ذیا کا نام عربی gốc ضیا سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے نور اور روشنی، اور اس نام کی اہمیت اسلام میں بڑی ہے جہاں قرآن کریم میں اللہ کو ضیاء کے ساتھ بیان کیا گیا ہے، اور جو لوگ یہ نام رکھتے ہیں وہ حکمت اور روشنی کے ساتھ منسلک ہوتے ہیں

in_hindi.name: ज़िया
in_hindi.long_meaning: ज़िया नाम अरबी gốc ضیا से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है प्रकाश और ज्योति, और इस नाम का महत्व इस्लाम में बहुत है जहां कुरान में अल्लाह को ज्योति के साथ वर्णित किया गया है, और जो लोग यह नाम रखते हैं वे ज्ञान और प्रकाश के साथ जुड़े होते हैं

in_pashto.name: ډیا
in_pashto.long_meaning: ډیا نوم د عربی gốc ضیا څخه اخیستل شوی دی چې د رڼا او نور په معنی دی، او دا نوم د اسلام په تعلیم کې ډیر महत्वपورنه دی ځکه چې د قرآن کریم په تعلیم کې الله د رڼا په توګه تشرېح شوی دی، او هغه کسان چې دا نوم خپل کوي د حكمت او رڼا سره تړلی دی

in_english.name: Dhiaa
in_english.long_meaning: Dhiaa is derived from the Arabic root dhia meaning light and illumination, and has significant importance in Islam as Allah is described with light in the Quran, and individuals with this name are associated with wisdom and enlightenment

pronunciation.urdu: ذیا کا تلفظ زیا کے طور پر کیا جاتا ہے
pronunciation.hindi: ज़िया का उच्चारण ज़िया के रूप में किया जाता है
pronunciation.pashto: ډیا د تلفظ ډیا په توګه کیږي

data.cultural_impact: The name Dhiaa in Arabic culture is associated with the idea of illumination, enlightenment, and guidance. It is a name that evokes images of brightness, radiance, and clarity. In Arabic literature and poetry, the term "dhiaa" is often used to describe a source of light or a brilliant idea.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Dhiaa is deeply significant as it is derived from the Arabic word for "God's light." In Islamic theology, God is seen as the ultimate source of light and guidance for all of creation. The name Dhiaa serves as a constant reminder of the divine light that illuminates our path and guides us towards the righteous way of living.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Dhiaa is mentioned in the book "The Golden Age of Islam" by Ibn Khaldun The name Dhiaa carried significant weight in that era.
